title: A stable restore-occurrence id in the restore record and status receipt, and a guard against a host binding between a restore's read and its completion
outcome: Stable restore-occurrence identity in the host-local restore record and status receipts, plus a documented destination-quiescence and session-identity contract; host-enforced admission exclusion is separately tracked in TermAl and is not delivered by this producer changeset.
acceptance: Each restore records a stable, opaque occurrence id that is distinct for repeated restores of the same copy. `backup status --json` (the receipt table and its test) and `doctor --json` carry it.

Destination quiescence is selected with both coordinators and documented in docs/host-checklist.md and docs/features/off-host-backup.md as a boundary the host must provide, not enforcement supplied by Engram. The boundary holds only when the operator or host actually excludes every opener of the physical destination, including independent CLI/library writers and aliases. Engram tests show its restore-record status and doctor readers take no restore-writer lock and do not mutate the restore record or store data, and pending/unreadable status remains fail-closed across tested restore failure windows. The item's notes cite TermAl w-4be3e96f76b8, which owns host-observed admission-exclusion evidence, with its actual state; that host enforcement remains open and is not claimed delivered by this producer change.

docs/host-checklist.md says to treat a pending or unreadable `restore` as: do not start consumers. It gives the per-restore-occurrence identity recipe TermAl accepted: a distinct asserted Engram identity mapping per store and per restore occurrence; existing sessions moved to it before reconnect or recovery; the same handled restore reused across a reboot.
The change is sent to TermAl's coordinator, and the item's notes record the mailbox sequence and TermAl's answer.

completion.summary: Delivered producer restore-occurrence UUID preserved across refetch/retry/completion/archive, distinct for repeated same-copy restores; status and doctor expose it and missing/invalid/nil records fail closed. Documented conditional all-opener destination exclusion and reboot-stable per-occurrence identity mapping. TermAl admission enforcement w-4be3e96f76b8 remains OPEN, not delivered here. Same-tree full gate and Codex/Claude round2 passed, independent acceptance 4/4 recorded. Pushed clean commit and installed release; all4 live stores ready, UTC-Z executable backup retained, no running session restart required.
